patch.description:
Applies the request body directly as the Prisma update payload for the B2BClient row — every writable client column can be set this way.

**Notes:** The body is passed straight to prisma.b2BClient.update({ data: body }) with no whitelist, so any unknown key produces a 500. Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_CLIENT).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/clients/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

post.description:
Uploads an authorization letter, GST/PAN certificate or bank account proof to Linode object storage and stores the resulting URL on the B2BClient row.

**Notes:** multipart/form-data — do not set Content-Type manually. Writes to Linode object storage via uploadB2BClientDocument and overwrites the matching *Url column on the client. Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_CLIENT). No file-size or MIME validation.

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/clients/[id]/documents/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

post.summary: Create a deal, direct buyback, or lead
post.description:
Three-way endpoint: with isDirectBuyback it transactionally creates a B2BLead + B2BClient + deal for a non-client seller; with clientId it creates a deal for an existing client; with neither it records a website/form inquiry as a new B2BLead.

**Notes:** Deal numbers are generated as B2B-<year>-<NNNN> by reading the latest matching dealNumber — not concurrency safe. Inspect `type` in the response to know which branch ran. Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_DEAL).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/deals/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

400.description: Missing seller.companyName, or missing name/phone for a new lead

example.error: Name and Phone are required for new leads

get.description:
Returns one deal with its client, all items (oldest first) and its 50 most recent log entries.

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/deals/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

put.description:
Applies a whitelisted set of updates to a deal — status (validated against the allowed transition map), quote amounts and notes, inspection details, corporate invoice and payment fields, and editable contact details — then writes a B2BDealLog entry.

**Notes:** SIDE EFFECTS on status=Approved: auto-generates the Purchase Order PDF for every deal, and additionally the Acknowledgement PDF for direct buybacks — both non-blocking (failures are logged to the deal trail, not returned). status=Approved stamps approvedAt; status=PaymentComplete stamps paymentDate. Allowed transitions: Format->DataRequested/FirstQuoteSent/Cancelled, DataRequested->DataReceived, DataReceived->FirstQuoteSent, FirstQuoteSent->InspectionScheduled, InspectionScheduled->InspectionComplete, InspectionComplete->FinalQuoteSent, FinalQuoteSent->Approved, Approved->InvoiceReceived, InvoiceReceived->PaymentRequested, PaymentRequested/PaymentPending->PaymentComplete (all also ->Cancelled). Closed is only reachable through POST /close. Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_DEAL).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/deals/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: Invalid status transition from Format to Approved

delete.description:
Soft-cancels the deal by setting status to Cancelled and appending a 'Deal Cancelled' log entry. No row is deleted.

**Notes:** Bypasses the STATUS_TRANSITIONS map entirely — any deal, in any status, can be cancelled here. Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_DEAL).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/deals/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

post.description:
Generates (or regenerates) the purchase Acknowledgement PDF for a deal, uploads it to S3 and saves the number, URL and timestamp on the deal.

**Notes:** force-dynamic, maxDuration 60s. Takes no request body. Uploads to S3 and mutates the deal. The same generator runs automatically when a direct-buyback deal moves to Approved via PUT /api/b2b-buyback/deals/{id}.

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/deals/[id]/acknowledgement/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: Add at least one item before generating an acknowledgement

post.summary: Close a deal and move items to inventory
post.description:
Closes a PaymentComplete deal: creates one ExcessBuyback InStock row per unit (with its serial and unit price), flips the deal to Closed with closedAt, and writes a deal log — all in one transaction.

**Notes:** MONEY/INVENTORY MUTATION. Only valid from status PaymentComplete; the plain PUT cannot set Closed. Refuses to close if any unit price from lib/b2b-pricing is missing or <= 0. Item.serial may hold a JSON array (one serial per unit). Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_DEAL, action STATUS_CHANGE).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/deals/[id]/close/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: Cannot close: these devices have no price captured (Apple iPhone 13). Complete the inspect…

put.summary: Bulk update deal items and recompute total
put.description:
Updates many items at once by id (quotes, condition, notes, serial). If any finalQuotePrice is supplied it recalculates the deal's finalQuoteAmount as the sum of finalQuotePrice x quantity across all items.

**Notes:** Side effect: rewrites B2BDeal.finalQuoteAmount when any finalQuotePrice is present. Updates run in parallel and are not transactional. Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity B2B_DEAL).

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/deals/[id]/items/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

500.description: Update failed (includes an unknown item id)

get.description:

_Source: `app/api/b2b-buyback/deals/[id]/items/[itemId]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

404.description: Item not found in this deal

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

items.description: Array of { id, firstQuotePrice?, finalQuotePrice?, condition?, inspectionNotes?, serial? }.

performedBy.description: Name recorded on the 'Deal Closed' log entry.

isDirectBuyback.description: Branch 1: create a direct buyback (lead + client + deal).

seller.description: Required when isDirectBuyback: { companyName (required), gstNumber, contactName, contactPhone, contactEmail, address, city, state, pincode, invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, invoiceUrl }.

clientId.description: Branch 2: create a deal for this existing B2BClient.

name.description: Branch 3 (lead): contact/company name. Required when neither isDirectBuyback nor clientId is set.

items.description: Optional initial items: { deviceType, brand, model, quantity }.

status.description: Target B2BDealStatus. Must be a legal transition from the current status; Closed is never reachable here.

firstQuoteAmount.description: First quote total; also stamps firstQuoteDate.

finalQuoteAmount.description: Final quote total; also stamps finalQuoteDate.

performedBy.description: Name recorded on the deal log entry.

logAction.description: Override the log entry's action label.

contactName.description: Contact name (mirrored to sellerContactName on direct buybacks).

sellerContactName.description: Seller contact name (mirrored to contactName on direct buybacks).

SuccessUrlEnvelope.description: Upload acknowledgement `{ success: true, url }` with the stored object URL.

items.description: Non-empty array of { deviceType, brand, model, serial?, quantity? }; quantity defaults to 1.

type.description: Interaction type, e.g. Call | Email | Meeting | Inquiry.

details.description: Free-text notes. Defaults to an empty string.

date.description: ISO timestamp of the interaction. Defaults to now.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
